headline: OpenAI and Meta have cautioned the US judiciary that fake AI-made 'deepfake' material could be offered as evidence in court, Reuters reports.
importance_line: Courts, lawyers and anyone involved in a trial may face doctored evidence, but what the companies asked the judiciary to do is not yet clear.
summary: Reuters reports that OpenAI and Meta have warned the US judiciary about the risk of deepfake evidence.
notes: Headline only: Reuters (401) and the Investing.com copy (403) were blocked. A second headline describes the recipient as a US judicial panel; details not read. Score lowered from 6 to 5 as unverified.
